citation.description: Ticket comment #1 provides live Gerrit API evidence: GET revisions/current/comments -> {} for 1636, 1666, 1685; GET /robotcomments -> 'robot comments unsupported'; count-only message on all three. Premise correction explicitly stated. Root cause traced to adapter.py:132 _summarize() PASS branch, 'finding' branch, _translate_findings, and voter.py:700.

criteria.criterion: AC1 — Root cause identified and recorded as a ticket comment (checked: comment #1 cites the live GET /a/changes/<n>/revisions/current/comments and /robotcomments responses), with the operator's '1636 is a counter-example' premise corrected against live Gerrit API state.

AC2 — Every advisory finding is retrievable from the Gerrit change: enumerated in the review message body on both the PASS and the BLOCK path, and additionally posted as an inline comment when its location anchors to a real path in the revision.
AC3 — A comment-posting failure is never silent: the vote still lands, and its message carries an explicit notice naming inline publication as failed and pointing at the durable code_review artifact.

AC4 — Regression tests pin: (a) advisory findings appear as text in the PASS message; (b) advisory text also appears on the BLOCK path; (c) an anchorable finding produces an inline comment keyed by path with unresolved: false; (d) an anchor-less or off-revision finding is still enumerated in the body and produces no inline comment; (e) a GerritError on the comment-bearing POST falls back to a message-only vote carrying the failure notice.

AC5 — make lint and make typecheck pass; no change to vote semantics — label name, vote values, PASS/BLOCK mapping, fail-closed coverage-gap behaviour and the dedup/retry bookkeeping are all untouched.
Bug 'Advisory review findings sometimes invisible on the Gerrit change' is actually resolved: the reported defect no longer reproduces and expected behavior holds.
